territory.label: The Receipt
territory.lens: itemized, audited transparency — every claim carries its number
territory.description: Treat the shoe like an invoice: publish the complete bill of materials, emissions and costs, and make checking the brand's work the core brand ritual.

big_idea: The Receipt Box: the shoebox is printed inside and out as the shoe's full audited receipt — unboxing is the audit, and the box mails back as the prepaid return label for end-of-life recovery.

art_direction.imagery_direction: Packaging-first photography: the open box as hero, lid interior dense with itemized data rows, shoe secondary; flat craft-paper textures and hard top light.
art_direction.layout_notes: Everything reads as printed matter: rubber-stamp marks, perforation lines, fold guides; the lid is the layout grid.

copy.headline: The box is the fine print.
copy.subhead: Every claim we make, printed where you can't miss it — then mail the box back and we take the shoe back too.
copy.body: Open the lid and you're holding the audit: materials, emissions, costs, misses, line by line. When the shoe is done, the box is the return label — send both back and we publish what we recovered.

critique.case_against: A packaging execution masquerading as a brand platform: the box is a delightful first touch, but it says nothing on foot, on the run, or at a retail wall where boxes are discarded, and the parent direction already owns the receipt idea in a place runners actually see daily. Unboxing theater also sits uneasily with an anti-waste story — the more the box matters, the more material and print the brand ships — and mail-back return logistics duplicate the rebuild territory's burdens without its payoff. Kill it or fold its best beat, the return-label lid, into the parent.

lens_tweak: make the shoebox itself the receipt — unboxing as audit
